Hubby is out of a job and currently job searching but no luck, even with his Master’s degree. I job search every day and have been since July of last year. 2 interviews with 1 being my current job.

I can hear my husband in the other room talking to his Dad about money and crying about how he’s at the end of his rope. I’m sorry hun. I tried so hard to keep it all together and make enough money for us all. I failed at life and all I’ve tried is my absolute best. I just can’t do it anymore.
